E0775

`{marker}`'s template writes declarations, but its row has no `Meta.Generate`

What

`{marker}`'s template writes declarations, but its row has no `Meta.Generate`

Why

A template whose row is `-[]>` only reads the program, so it may reject or warn but not add code

Fix

Write `-[Meta.Generate]>` on `{marker}`'s `expand`, or remove the declarations its template writes

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0775: tests/ui/effects/lint_generates_outside_row_is_e0775.stderr.
